description: Defines the StreamBufferCache class which manages cached stream buffers for camera device implementation, including methods for retrieving, removing, updating, and clearing buffers, as well as removing streams except specified ones.

classes.name: StreamBufferCache
classes.description: A class that manages a cache of stream buffers for camera device sessions, providing thread-safe access and modification methods.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cached stream buffer by its buffer ID.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a cached stream buffer by its buffer ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the cache with a new or modified stream buffer.

methods.name: removeStreamsExcept
methods.description: Removes all stream buffers except those associated with the specified stream IDs.
